errors.name: required option after an optional one
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Group: `Utility`
  Slash option: `a string first`
  Slash option: `b user! second`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Option "b" is required but follows an optional one: write the required options first (the panel stores them that way)

errors.name: required subcommand option after an optional one
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Group: `Utility`
  Slash subcommand: `get read`
  Slash option: `get.a string first`
  Slash option: `get.b user! second`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Subcommand "get": Option "b" is required but follows an optional one: write the required options first (the panel stores them that way)

errors.name: menu option type
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Group: `Utility`
  Slash option: `flavor string_menu! the flavor`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Option "flavor": type "string_menu" is a choices menu, which a header can't express (the panel shows it back as "string"): use "string"

errors.name: long slash description
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash description: `ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash command description must be between 1 and 100 characters

errors.name: empty slash description
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash description: ``
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash command description must be between 1 and 100 characters

errors.name: deployable slash command without a description
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Group: `Utility`
  Slash option: `key string k`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash description: a Slash Command needs a `Slash description:` line (1-100 characters)

errors.name: slash description on a message trigger
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash description: `d`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash description needs a Slash Command trigger

errors.name: unknown defer mode
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Defer mode: `Later`
*/}}
errors.error: header Defer mode: `Later` isn't one of the panel's: None, Message Response, Ephemeral Message Response, Update Message Response

errors.name: case sensitive not a boolean
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Case sensitive: `yes`
*/}}
errors.error: header Case sensitive: `yes` isn't true or false

errors.name: uppercase name
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `Probe`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash command name must be lowercase

errors.name: name with a space
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `my cmd`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash command name must be 1-32 characters and contain only letters, numbers, dashes and underscores

errors.name: update defer
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Defer mode: `Update Message Response`
*/}}
errors.error: header: "Update message" defer mode is not valid for slash commands

errors.name: bad option row
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `key string`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash option `key string`: write `[sub.]name type[!] description` (type: string, string_menu, integer, integer_menu, number, number_menu, boolean, user, channel, role, mentionable; ! = required)

errors.name: unknown type
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `key text! the key`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Invalid type for option "key": "text!" isn't one of string, string_menu, integer, integer_menu, number, number_menu, boolean, user, channel, role, mentionable

errors.name: uppercase option
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `Key string the key`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Option name "Key" must be lowercase

errors.name: bad option name
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `ke$y string the key`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Option name "ke$y" must be 1-32 characters (letters, numbers, dashes, underscores)

errors.name: duplicate option
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `key string a`
  Slash option: `key string b`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Duplicate option name "key"

errors.name: long description
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `key string ddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Description for option "key" must be between 1 and 100 characters

errors.name: too many options
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `o string an option`
  Slash option: `ox string an option`
  Slash option: `oxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
  Slash option: `oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx string an option`
*/}}
errors.error: header: can have at most 25 options

errors.name: bad subcommand row
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `get`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash subcommand `get`: write `name description`

errors.name: uppercase subcommand
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `Get read`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Subcommand name "Get" must be lowercase

errors.name: duplicate subcommand
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `get a`
  Slash subcommand: `get b`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Duplicate subcommand name "get"

errors.name: subcommand option error is prefixed
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `get a`
  Slash option: `get.Key string k`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Subcommand "get": Option name "Key" must be lowercase

errors.name: top-level option with subcommands
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `get a`
  Slash option: `key string k`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash option `key string k`: a command with subcommands has no top-level options; write `<subcommand>.key ...`

errors.name: option of an unknown subcommand
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Slash Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash subcommand: `get a`
  Slash option: `set.key string k`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash option `set.key string k`: no Slash subcommand line names "set" (subcommand lines come first)

errors.name: option rows on a message trigger
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Command`
  Trigger: `x`
  Slash option: `key string k`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Slash option and Slash subcommand lines need a Slash Command trigger

errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `User Context Menu`
  Trigger: `View`
  Defer mode: `Update Message Response`

errors.error: header: "Update message" defer mode is not valid for context menu commands

errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Message Context Menu`
  Trigger: `Quote!`
*/}}
errors.error: header: Context menu command name must be 1-32 characters and contain only letters, numbers, spaces, dashes and underscores

errors.name: hourly interval without Interval
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Hourly interval`
  Group: `Utility`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: a `Hourly interval` trigger needs an `Interval:` line

errors.name: minute interval without Interval
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Minute interval`
  Group: `Utility`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: a `Minute interval` trigger needs an `Interval:` line

errors.name: interval of zero
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Hourly interval`
  Interval: `0`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `0` isn't a positive whole number

errors.name: interval negative
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Minute interval`
  Interval: `-5`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `-5` isn't a positive whole number

errors.name: interval not a number
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Hourly interval`
  Interval: `daily`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `daily` isn't a positive whole number

errors.name: hourly interval above 744
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Hourly interval`
  Interval: `745`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `745` isn't between 1 and 744 hours

errors.name: minute interval below 5
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Minute interval`
  Interval: `4`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `4` isn't between 5 and 44640 minutes

errors.name: minute interval above 44640
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Minute interval`
  Interval: `44641`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `44641` isn't between 5 and 44640 minutes

errors.name: minute interval of whole hours
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Minute interval`
  Interval: `120`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `120` minutes is whole hours: use `Hourly interval`

errors.name: interval fractional
errors.source:
{{/*
  Trigger type: `Hourly interval`
  Interval: `1.5`
*/}}
errors.error: header Interval: `1.5` isn't a positive whole number
